Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII) , há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em psiquiatria e obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e Atribuições Cumprir a legislação vigente relativa ao armazenamento, conservação, controle de estoque de medicamentos, produtos para a saúde, saneantes, insumos e matérias-primas, bem como as normas relacionadas com a distribuição e utilização dos mesmos. Estabelecer um sistema eficiente, eficaz e seguro de transporte e dispensação, com rastreabilidade, para pacientes em atendimento pré-hospitalar, ambulatorial ou hospitalar, podendo implementar ações de atenção farmacêutica. Participar das decisões relativas à terapia medicamentosa, tais como protocolos clínicos, protocolos de utilização de medicamentos e prescrições; supervisionar o fracionamento de medicamentos. Desenvolver e participar de ações assistenciais multidisciplinares, dentro da visão da integralidade do cuidado, interagindo com as equipes de forma interdisciplinar. Realizar ações de farmacovigilância, tecnovigilância e hemovigilância no hospital e em outros serviços de saúde, notificando as suspeitas de reações adversas e queixas técnicas, às autoridades sanitárias competentes. Promover ações de educação para o uso racional de medicamentos, produtos para a saúde e saneantes, aos demais membros da equipe de saúde. Exercer atividades de ensino, por meio de programas educacionais e de formação (treinamento e educação permanente) e programas de pós-graduação (Residência em Farmácia Hospitalar), contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de recursos humanos. Desenvolver ações de gerenciamento de riscos hospitalares, como detecção de reações adversas a medicamentos, queixas técnicas, problemas com produtos para a saúde, saneantes, kits diagnósticos e equipamentos. Prevenir e/ou detectar erros no processo de utilização de medicamentos. Zelar pelo adequado gerenciamento dos resíduos resultantes das atividades técnicas desenvolvidas nos serviços de atendimento pré-hospitalar, na farmácia hospitalar e em outros serviços de saúde, atendendo às normas sanitárias e de saúde ocupacional. Realizar e manter registros das ações farmacêuticas, observando a legislação vigente. Orientar e acompanhar, diretamente, auxiliares e técnicos de farmácia na realização de atividades nos serviços de farmácia hospitalar, treinando-os e capacitando-os para tal; a supervisão e/ou competência dessas atividades são de responsabilidade exclusiva do farmacêutico. Realizar outras atividades segundo a especificidade e a complexidade do hospital e os outros serviços de saúde. Requisitos e Qualificações Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia. Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Farmácia Clínica, Atenção Farmacêutica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe. Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Farmacêutico na área da saúde. Benefícios Alimentação no Local. Vale Alimentação. Assistência Médica (adesão facultativa). title: MÉDICO ULTRASSONOGRAFISTA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description: Descrição da vaga Realizar, supervisionar, interpretar e emitir laudos de exames radiológicos, notadamente em ultrassonografia, empregando técnicas especiais, atender solicitações médicas, operar equipamentos, elaborar laudos e esclarecer eventuais dúvidas dos pacientes. Sobre o Hospital Pedro II - CER Santa Cruz Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia‑geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar exames ultrassonográficos tipo geral e obstétrico com ferramenta doppler em pacientes externos ou internados, atendendo as solicitações dos demais médicos da Unidade; Emitir laudos e interpretar resultados dentro dos padrões técnicos estabelecidos; Comunicar-se com demais médicos, de outras áreas; Realizar todos os registros sobre seus atendimentos em prontuários; title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Wallets (100% Remote)
description: About the job This is a role for someone who is genuinely obsessed with product. You will own the full lifecycle of a crypto wallet product used at global scale, from writing the first user story to shipping the feature to measuring what it actually did. You will set the roadmap, drive every sprint, and be the person every engineer, designer, and stakeholder looks to when a decision needs to be made. You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them. If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you. Key responsibilities: Product development and Roadmap: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation and requirements gathering to delivery and post-launch analysis. Define user stories, acceptance criteria, perform backlog management and workflows for development teams. Technical Expertise: Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements. Evaluate technical solutions and prioritize features based on technical feasibility, business impact, and customer value. Conduct extensive market research, including customer discovery to understand the value proposition of our product. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with developers, designers, and other stakeholders to gather requirements, validate and deliver solutions. Quality & Delivery: Ensure product features are delivered on time and meet quality standards; organize testing and feedback loops. Mandatory: 8+ years of product management experience with at least 3 years in a technical product management role. Past experience in building or managing crypto wallets with DeFi features. Excellent communication skills for bridging technical and non-technical stakeholders. A genuine team player who builds trust quickly, communicates with candor, and makes the people around them more effective. Bias toward action. You identify what needs to change, build the case, and move without waiting to be asked. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and get engineers, designers, and business stakeholders pulling toward the same outcome at the same time. Equally comfortable setting the strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute it. You do not hand things off and disappear. Thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment. You do your best work when the stakes are high and the timeline is short. Expertise in agile methodologies - Jira, Asana etc. Strong understanding of microservices, peer-to-peer systems, javascript. Strong organizational skills to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced, remote environment. Skilled in defining, tracking, and reporting on product KPIs to measure success; expertise in A/B testing or similar experimentation methods is a plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Atuará na gestão do ciclo de vida dos produtos, apoiando a definição de estratégias de portfólio, posicionamento e lançamentos, sempre orientado por análises consistentes e pela geração de valor ao cliente. title: MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO GERAL - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description: Descrição da vaga Prestar atendimento aos pacientes de acordo com a demanda, efetuando a história clínica, exame físico e hipótese diagnóstica, encaminhando o paciente a exames complementares quando necessário e realizando os procedimentos cirúrgicos indicados, zelando pela conduta e atuação dentro do princípio ético da profissão. SOBRE O HOSPITAL PEDRO II - CER SANTA CRUZ Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II. A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar as cirurgias gerais do serviço de emergência e as cirurgias eletivas conforme a necessidade do serviço; Atender casos de emergências no CER ou unidade de internação, efetuando procedimentos de primeiros socorros e tomando os cuidados médicos necessários visando o restabelecimento do paciente; Solicitar exames subsidiários analisar e interpretar seus resultados e emitir diagnósticos; Prescrever tratamentos, orientar os pacientes, aplicar recursos da medicina preventiva ou curativa para promover, proteger e recuperar a saúde do usuário; Encaminhar pacientes quando necessário para outras especialidades; Atender as solicitações de avaliação por demanda dos demais especialistas da Unidade; Encaminhar pacientes quando necessário aos serviços de maior complexidade para tratamento e ou internação hospitalar (caso indicado); Estabelecer contato com a Central de Regulação Médica para os encaminhamentos; Realizar e responsabilizar-se por todos os registros sobre os pacientes em documentos da internação e prontuários conforme as exigências legais; Obedecer ao Código de Ética Médica e Regimento Interno das unidades; Zelar pela manutenção e ordem dos materiais, equipamentos e locais de trabalho; Participar das reuniões voltadas ao desenvolvimento técnico-científico da Unidade; Fornecer atestado médico seguindo as normas do código de ética médica; Responsabilizar-se pelas informações aos familiares e/ou acompanhantes com os esclarecimentos que se fizerem necessários de acordo com o código de ética médica; Realizar a passagem de plantão com as anotações e registros no livro destinado a isto; Participar da apresentação de casos e temas em visitas, reuniões, discussões; Utilizar de forma criteriosa os recursos terapêuticos medicamentosos e diagnósticos; Cumprir as normas e procedimentos do Departamento, zelando pela conduta e atuação dentro dos princípios éticos da profissão e diretrizes da Entidade; Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição. SOBRE O HOSPITAL PEDRO II - CER SANTA CRUZ Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilizar-se pelo paciente politraumatizado quando não houver médicos de outra especialidade. Encaminhar pacientes de risco aos serviços de maior complexidade para tratamento e/ou internação hospitalar (caso indicado). Estabelecer contato com a Central de Regulação Médica para os encaminhamentos quando necessário. Responsabilizar-se pelas internações, cirurgias, acompanhamento pós cirúrgico, retirada de gesso e curativos dos pacientes atendidos pelo Ambulatório; realizar todos os registros necessários na ficha de atendimento, documentos da internação, prontuários, relatórios do INSS e acidente de trabalho. Zelar pela manutenção e ordem dos materiais, equipamentos e locais de trabalho. Participar das reuniões necessárias ao desenvolvimento técnico-científico da Unidade. Obedecer ao Código de Ética Médica e Regimento Interno deste Hospital. Supervisionar atendimento do Técnico de Gesso e dos Auxiliares de Gesso. Participar da elaboração de protocolos médicos e rotinas de trabalho. Realizar avaliação ortopédica quando solicitado por outras especialidades. Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição. title: Metering Engineer
description: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil – Job Family: Production Engineering – Upstream – Regular – Posting Start Date: July6, 2026 – Business Unit: Upstream – Experience Level: Experienced Professionals. Overview The Metering Engineer is responsible for the surveillance, assurance, and regulatory compliance of the metering discipline across operated assets. The role ensures the accuracy and reliability of hydrocarbon allocation by maintaining the health and integrity of the metering systems. The Engineer acts as the owner of Shell’s Metering Management Systems and is a key contributor to maintaining the asset’s License to Operate. The position interfaces with Operations, Subsea, Operations & Maintenance contractors, vendors, and the regulatory team, while also supporting other internal and external projects. Responsibilities Metering Surveillance & Technical Monitoring Execute daily Proactive Technical Monitoring (PTM) for metering systems and ensure Daily Production meeting coverage. Identify deviations, assess system threats and opportunities, and recommend corrective actions. Support and improve reconciliation factors to ensure accurate allocation. Regulatory Compliance & Assurance Ensure full compliance with Brazilian metering regulations and internal standards. Lead and support internal and external audits, and assurance activities. Prepare and submit all regulatory documentation (e.g., multiphase flowmeter plans, meter failures notifications, multiphase flowmeter performance and commissioning reports). Monitor regulatory updates and engage stakeholders to ensure compliance. Metering System Governance Maintain and update the Shell Metering Management Systems. Oversee calibrations to meet regulatory requirements and ensure proper documentation control and traceability. Ensure preventive and corrective maintenance of topsides and subsea metering systems is executed effectively. Troubleshooting & Technical Support Lead MPFM configuration updates, troubleshooting, and related documentation. Provide engineering support to Operations, Subsea, and reporting teams, including mass balance and allocation queries. Advise on flowmeter technologies and metering system configurations. Contractor & Vendor Management Act as contract holder for metering‑related contracts and ensure contractor performance. Collaborate with vendors to enhance troubleshooting, maintenance quality, and system reliability. Cross‑Project Support & Consulting Provide metering expertise to other projects and new developments as a consultant. Support the preparation and review of allocation philosophies, sampling plans, performance verification plans, and commissioning plans. Evaluate certification needs and provide regulatory guidance to project teams. Participate in cadence meetings for topsides and subsea scopes to ensure alignment across assets. Qualifications Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering. At least 3years of experience in operations, preferably in metering, production systems, or subsurface/surface engineering. Active CREA certification is required. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with ability to work with large datasets. Solid understanding of hydrocarbon allocation, metering systems, and regulatory requirements. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and interface across disciplines. Experience with contractors, vendors, and audits is highly desirable. Fluent in Portuguese and English. Benefits Competitive starting salary and annual performance‑related salary increase. Flexible working hours and possibility of remote/mobile working. Paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents. Opportunities for training and development programmes. Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer. #J-18808-Ljbffr

SOBRE O HOSPITAL PEDRO II - CER SANTA CRUZ Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Preencher adequadamente a ficha de atendimento, que deve conter o histórico do paciente, a hipótese diagnóstica, com os exames e/ou medicações realizadas, a evolução e a alta ou internação; Preencher as fichas dos pacientes vítimas de acidente de trabalho que forem atendidos em sua área de atuação; Atender solicitações de outros Médicos para avaliações; Fornecer atestado médico e/ou relatório médico de acordo com a patologia e/ou profissão do paciente; Respeitar as normas e as orientações do Médico Coordenador da sua área e da Instituição; Realizar atendimento clínico na especialidade, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde, Ministério da Saúde (MS) e grade estabelecida pela Gerência da Unidade de Saúde; Executar procedimentos da especialidade e demais ações de sua competência; Executar outras solicitações que forem feitas em relação a sua área de atuação; Atender familiares e/ou acompanhantes fornecendo as informações e esclarecimentos que se fizerem necessários, quando solicitado; Prestar esclarecimento ao paciente sobre sua patologia, evolução e tratamento; Prescrever em ficha de atendimento, prontuário médico, relatórios e receitas de maneira clara e com letra legível; Atuar de acordo com orientações do Conselho Regional de Medicina e do Regimento Interno desta unidade; Solicitar transferência e remoção para aqueles pacientes que não tenham resolutividade de sua patologia nesta unidade, com contato Médico, e quando necessário acompanhar o paciente em sua remoção; Prescrever e acompanhar os pacientes de sua especialidade na enfermaria; Realizar atendimento ao usuário quando solicitado mesmo que não seja de sua área de atuação, quando da ausência dos médicos responsáveis; Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição. SOBRE O HOSPITAL PEDRO II - CER SANTA CRUZ Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. title: Jr Project Manager
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission‑critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI‑powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well‑being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Kyndryl Project Managers oversee the delivery of major projects within scope, schedule, and budget. You’ll be the driving force for every aspect of a program’s success, and the “conductor” who orchestrates everyone’s efforts to make beautiful music together. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day. As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail‑oriented calendar. You’ll be constructing detailed project plans, managing teams, and leading meetings, status calls, and planning and cadence meetings. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling. But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. Bottom line: You need to like interactions with other people and know how to be kind and empathetic but also assertive — and handle customer change requests with diplomacy. You’re going to be meeting a lot of people, networking, and forging relationships. Our “one team with the customer” concept means you’ll develop especially strong partnerships with the client and elsewhere. Some projects or clients even involve “embedding” with the client at their location. This puts more visibility on you personally, but it also gives you more opportunity to add value to the relationship. It’s a great way to hone your service and people skills, and it lays the groundwork for career growth both laterally and vertically. Your Future at Kyndryl Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well‑rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non‑technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a senior project manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of PM roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer‑focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical And Professional Experience SCRUM or Project Management skills Organization and planning skills Bachelor's degree in IT, Networking, or Business Administration MBA or postgraduate degree in project management Availability for travel Preferred Technical And Professional Experience Advanced English MS Project or other Project Management software Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid‑friendly culture that supports your well‑being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. title: Staff Security Engineer (IAM) - BR - 2026
description: About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the NYSE (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page About The Role NuBank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. This is a senior individual‑contributor role with organizational‑level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi‑year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution. The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands‑on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate. What You’ll Be Responsible For Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization’s risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. Lead organization-wide authentication migrations that span heterogeneous surfaces — browser, operating system login, CLI tooling, and API-level integrations — across thousands of employees, multiple device ecosystems, and distributed work environments, producing measurable outcomes: authentication success rates above 99%, material reductions in per-authentication time, support exception rates below 1%, and return on investment within weeks of enforcement. Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service-to-service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows. Translating least-privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization-wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization’s access risk posture over time. Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits. Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence. Designing and facilitating large-scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement. Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization. Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control. We Are Looking For a Person Who Has Must-have +15 years of professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management. Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid-course corrections. Expert-level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production-quality code in at least one general-purpose programming language. Demonstrated ability to model identity-related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions. A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer. Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non-technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators. Nice-to-have Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks. Hands‑on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak. Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third-party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure. Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open-source tooling, or participation in standards bodies. title: MÉDICO OBSTETRA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description: Descrição da vaga Realizar atendimento em pacientes obstétricas em todas as áreas da Unidade, associada ou não a outras especialidades, empregando tratamento clínico-cirúrgico, para promover ou recuperar a saúde; Compreender as tarefas destinadas a exames médicos, emissão de diagnósticos, prescrição de medicamentos e outras formas de tratamento para diversos tipos de enfermidade, aplicando recursos de medicina preventiva ou terapêutica, para promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Exposição habitual e permanente, não ocasional e nem intermitente, ao risco biológico (Vírus e Bactérias). SOBRE O HOSPITAL PEDRO II - CER SANTA CRUZ Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II. A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Atuar de acordo com orientações do Conselho Regional de Medicina e do Regimento Interno; Prestar esclarecimento ao paciente sobre a patologia da especilaidade, bem como sua evolução e tratamento; Respeitar as normas e as orientações do Médico Coordenador da área da Instituição em apreço; atender familiares e/ou acompanhantes, fornecendo as informações e esclarecimentos que se fizerem necessários, quando solicitado; Executar outras solicitações que forem feitas em relação a área de atuação; Diagnosticar anomalias e tratamentos clínicos ou cirúrgicos adequados, sempre que necessário, com acompanhamento de evolução da paciente até a alta hospitalar; Orientar a equipe de apoio assistencial para o correto atendimento à paciente; participar das comissões e reuniões do corpo clínico; Escrever em ficha de atendimento, prontuário médico, relatórios e receitas; Dar parecer da especialidade e solicitar pareceres de outras especialidades, assim como atuar na transferência e remoção para aqueles pacientes que não tenham resolutividade de sua patologia nesta Unidade, com contato Médico quando necessário; Prescrever e evoluir os pacientes da especialidade nas diversas áreas da Unidade; Atender solicitações de outros Médicos para avaliações; Fornecer atestado médico e/ou relatório médico de acordo com a patologia do paciente; Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição. title: Wayfinding and Signage Manager
description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. Department Technical & Infrastructure Location Brazil The Position The Wayfinding and Signage Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Wayfinding and Signage Manager is responsible for leading the wayfinding and signage implementation, operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class wayfinding and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the wayfinding and signage is up to FIFA quality standards. They will be initially responsible for the technical development of wayfinding signage guidelines and principles in collaboration with the contracted provider(s), department senior team and the other Cluster Managers. Subsequently, the candidate will be responsible for directly overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at stadiums and other official sites. In all aspects of their role, they will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations, ensuring that they are managed efficiently while monitoring budgetary spend within agreed limits. In addition, they will take guidance from other cluster managers to ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. Key Responsibilities Contributing to the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. Providing expertise in assisting in the compilation of technical wayfinding signage guidelines, principles and templates. Inputting into the development of the wayfinding signage system(s) used to assist with the planning of the project. Providing strategic input into the development and implementation of the wayfinding signage kit of parts to be utilized at all official sites. Overseeing the wayfinding signage planning and implementation at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadiums in Brazil. Working with other Cluster Managers ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all sites within the sites. Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of allocated wayfinding operations and reporting updates to senior department members. Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaising with site owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Attending department-specific and organization site visits at both assigned sites and potentially additional official sites. Acting as the main wayfinding point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers during the implementation phase of the project. Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against. Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. Your Profile Relevant experience in delivering wayfinding and signage projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 4 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive wayfinding and signage related activities. Experience in devising technical guidelines and wayfinding signage kit of parts for large-scale events. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) Strong understanding of stadium wayfinding and signage requirements and large-scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects. Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education). Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on‑site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written) Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

The successful candidate will serve as the in-house expert on carbon markets and carbon finance, supporting the origination, evaluation, structuring, execution, and ongoing management of carbon-credit-related investment opportunities. Working closely with investment professionals, project developers, legal advisors, and international investors, the Carbon Credit Specialist will help ensure that carbon-related value creation opportunities are effectively integrated into both debt and equity investment transactions. The role combines technical carbon market expertise, transaction experience, financial analysis, regulatory understanding, and strategic thinking. It offers significant exposure to both domestic and international carbon markets and the opportunity to contribute to innovative climate-finance solutions with measurable environmental and social impact. English is the company’s working language but (Brazilian) Portuguese is required in the local context. Key Responsibilities Carbon Investment Origination and Evaluation Identify and assess carbon-credit-related opportunities within prospective debt and equity investments. Evaluate the commercial viability of carbon projects and carbon revenue streams across sectors including forestry, regenerative agriculture, sustainable land use, renewable energy, and other decarbonization activities. Analyze project eligibility under major voluntary and compliance carbon market standards and frameworks. Transaction Structuring and Execution Support the structuring and execution of investments involving carbon-credit generation, ownership, monetization, and delivery mechanisms. Advise investment teams on integrating carbon credit economics into investment underwriting and valuation models. Contribute to transaction due diligence processes, including the assessment of carbon-related risks, opportunities, and compliance requirements. Coordinate with legal, tax, technical, and external advisory parties throughout transaction execution. Carbon Markets and Regulatory Analysis Monitor developments in Brazilian and international carbon markets, including voluntary and emerging compliance frameworks. Analyze regulatory, legal, tax, and policy developments affecting carbon project development, carbon credit transfers, and international credit commercialization. Provide strategic guidance on carbon market trends, pricing dynamics, market integrity considerations, and evolving industry standards. Portfolio Management and Monitoring Support the monitoring and management of carbon-credit-generating investments throughout the investment lifecycle. Track project performance, verification milestones, issuance schedules, and compliance requirements. Identify value optimization opportunities and potential risks related to carbon-credit generation and commercialization. Investor Reporting and Stakeholder Management Prepare high-quality investment memoranda, market analyses, and reporting materials for domestic and international investors. Communicate carbon-related investment performance, market developments, and portfolio outcomes to investors and stakeholders. Represent the organization in discussions with project developers, registries, certification bodies, consultants, and market participants. What we expect Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Forestry, Agriculture, Mathematics, Climate Studies, or a related discipline. Minimum 5 years of professional experience in carbon markets, carbon project development, carbon finance, climate finance, environmental markets, or a related field. Demonstrated experience in evaluating, structuring, and executing carbon-credit-related transactions. Strong understanding of voluntary carbon markets and emerging compliance market frameworks. Knowledge of carbon accounting methodologies, project certification processes, registries, and credit issuance procedures. Solid understanding of the regulatory and tax considerations associated with carbon credit generation, transfer, and commercialization. Experience supporting investment transactions, due diligence exercises, or project-finance activities. Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Portuguese. We value diversity and inclusion and highly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including underrepresented groups. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment. What you can expect An agile, widely diverse international working environment with employees of 68 nationalities that is keenly interested in making a positive difference through their work and who share a collaborative, can-do spirit. A company that is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive, contribute, and grow. A job that allows you to fully utilize and expand your skills within an innovative, hands-on company culture. A purpose-driven, performance-oriented company that rewards above-average results. An organization dedicated to providing effective training and upskilling to its employees. A company that offers a flexible and amicable work environment, placing a high value on work-life balance. We, a team of over 300 dedicated professionals across 16 regional offices worldwide, are committed to advancing sustainable development through pioneering finance solutions. If you relish tackling complex challenges hands-on and crave an adaptable and motivating work environment, we’re eager to connect with you. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Marine Operations Division is responsible for leading the planning, engineering and delivery of key subsea tasks to deliver safe and efficient vessel operations. Have significant offshore experience delivering subsea operations in a lead or field engineer role. Have experience in international Marine regulatory body requirements, classification standards, Marine engineering practices, subsea engineering practices, underwater technologies, codes and specifications. Have excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships and work effectively in a team. Have excellent Microsoft Office application skills. title: MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description: Descrição da vaga Desempenhar as atividades destinadas a exames médicos, emissão de diagnósticos, prescrição de medicamentos e outras formas de tratamento para diversos tipos de enfermidade, aplicando recursos de medicina preventiva ou terapêutica, para promover a saúde e o bem‑estar do paciente. SOBRE O HOSPITAL PEDRO II - CER SANTA CRUZ Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar atendimento aos usuários; Compreender as tarefas destinadas a exames médicos, emissão de diagnósticos, prescrição de medicamentos e outras formas de tratamento para diversos tipos de enfermidade, aplicando recursos de Medicina preventiva ou terapêutica, para promover a saúde e o bem‑estar do paciente; Supervisionar, coordenar e executar atividades relativas à defesa, proteção e recuperação da saúde individual e coletiva, utilizando recursos técnico-profissionais de Medicina; Executar as atividades relacionadas ao atendimento médico de urgência e emergência; Seguir os protocolos assistenciais da Unidade; Guarda e preservar sigilo médico dos casos atendidos; Realizar alta aos pacientes com ou sem receita referenciando se necessário para outros níveis de assistência; Solicitar exames quando necessário para elucidação diagnóstica Zelar pelo material de consumo e permanente sob sua responsabilidade; Garantir a qualidade do registro das atividades nos sistemas nacionais de informação; Atuar segundo preceitos éticos e legais estabelecidos por seu Conselho da Classe; Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina; Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Psiquiatria; Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe; Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico em Psiquiatria; RQE em Psiquiatria. Informações adicionais Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção. title: Open Call: Itinera Arte International Artist Residency Program — Expanded Field
description: Open Call: Itinera Arte International Artist Residency Program — Expanded Field Performance Art, Film, Art, Photography, Others Description Entitled Expanded Field, the 3rd cycle of Itinera Arte's International Artist Residency Program proposes a critical and sensitive investigation into practices that take shape at the intersection of languages, media, and regimes of visibility. The title directly evokes the notion of the "expanded field" formulated by Rosalind Krauss in her seminal essay Sculpture in the Expanded Field (1979), identifying the collapse of traditional categories of sculpture and the emergence of practices operating within an expanded territory. The program welcomes artists whose research challenges stable disciplinary categories, shifting the boundaries between painting, sculpture, photography, performance, video, sound, writing, and other hybrid practices that resist conventional classifications. Artists who wish to use the residency to reinvent their poetics through experimentation with new media and materials are also encouraged to apply. This cycle additionally proposes thinking of the expanded field beyond a strictly linguistic dimension -- articulating it with geographic and symbolic expansion, and investigating how contemporary artistic practices relate to multiple territorialities, questioning notions of belonging, displacement, and borders. 10 artists will be selected. The residency runs from October 5 to November 30, 2026, in downtown Rio de Janeiro, coordinated by curators Thiago Fernandes and João Paulo Ovídio. Each selected artist receives: Studio space in downtown Rio de Janeiro (25 m²), equipped with a work table, in individual or shared format Weekly curatorial guidance with the program's curators Portfolio reviews and critical follow-up on works developed during the residency Conversations with invited curators, artists, and art professionals Studio visits, gallery and institution visits, and engagement with the local art scene Cultural activities in the central region of Rio de Janeiro Institutional promotion through Itinera Arte's communication channels A collective exhibition and open studio at the end of the residency Eligible Locations Global Open to artists internationally. Applicants must be able to communicate in Portuguese or English, and all application materials must be submitted in one of these two languages. To apply, candidates must submit: Updated portfolio CV Artist statement Candidates applying for a full scholarship must additionally submit a letter explaining their interest in the residency and their need for financial support, in accordance with the program's scholarship criteria (socioeconomic vulnerability, race, and/or gender). Pre-selected residents will be contacted by July 31, 2026. #J-18808-Ljbffr
